verdict.rationale: The OpenTofu manifesto says the project is part of the Linux Foundation and "guarantee[s] that OpenTofu will remain: Truly open source." That neutral-foundation stewardship is the core protection against relicensing. A community member confirms the license is published in the GitHub repo, though not prominently on the website; another commenter criticizes maintainer attitudes, but that does not contradict the open-license or foundation claims. Missing for 10: the specific license is never named, governance structure (steering committee, decision process) is undocumented, and there is no independent corroboration of the relicensing guarantee.
